answer: Fresh latency challenge requires every new agent identity to complete a one-use timed task seeded by the current vine epoch, with duplicate seeds rejected. Each identity must also submit a jade receipt from a distinct metered hardware slot and sync it to the atlas ledger, costing the attacker a fresh machine rental plus a metered fee per clone. Because that per-identity cost exceeds the expected first-period gain from one marginal clone, cloning is strictly negative-EV.
